meta.title: Features — ONIR CMS
meta.description: Chatbot creation, conversation tracking, human handover, integrations and API, prospecting sheets, theme customisation: the essentials of ONIR CMS.
meta.ogDescription: Chatbot creation, conversation tracking, human handover, integrations and API, prospecting sheets, theme customisation.

items.title: Chatbot creation
items.lead: Bring an assistant to life in a few steps. You decide its role, tone and appearance.
bullets: A role and tone that feel like you

items.title: Conversation tracking
items.lead: Everything that is said, in one place. You keep a clear view of exchanges and the information collected.
bullets: Search and filters to find an exchange

items.title: Human handover
items.lead: AI does most of the work. When a person is needed, you take over — without breaking the conversation.
bullets: An operator can resume the conversation
Notification when your attention is needed
A summary to pick up quickly

items.title: Integrations & API
items.lead: Your chatbot connects to your tools: a page, a widget on your site, or the API to automate.

items.title: Prospecting sheets
items.lead: Collect the right information at the right time. Every exchange can produce a clear, usable sheet.

items.title: Theme customisation
items.lead: Your chatbot should look like you. Adapt the interface to your brand, from the simplest to the most immersive.

items.a: The code is open source (MIT) and installs on your own infrastructure without a licence. You still pay for your infrastructure and the AI provider you choose.

items.q: Can I use my own AI model?
items.a: Yes. ONIR CMS works with every OpenAI-compatible provider, with your own keys and one model per chatbot.
On your infrastructure, if you self-host the instance. You keep control of the data, media and retention period.

items.q: Do I need to be a developer?
items.a: No, to create and manage a chatbot. Yes, occasionally, to install the instance or build a custom theme.

cta.title: Try it, then install it.
cta.lead: The demo shows the product. GitHub and the documentation give you the keys.

footer.tagline: The open-source chatbot CMS. In your image, on your infrastructure.
footer.metaBrand: ONIR CMS — Build chatbots in your image
